beats.narration: Checked, not trusted. Before a site goes live, its pipeline checks who signed every new commit. An unknown key stops the deploy.
On the twenty-second of November, a site went live from commits signed by an unpublished key. Nothing refused it. Only Dinis noticed.

caption:
Who keeps dozens of AI agents in line? A written policy.

Every repository behind Sovereign Website has an Agent Behaviour Policy: what each agent may change, where it may push, and what needs the owner's yes. Anything not listed is refused. Every agent signs its work with its own key, and every site checks who signed before it goes live.

When a site once went live from a key nobody had published, a signer check was added for every site within two hours. The policy learns.

Changing the rules needs the owner's yes.

The presenter, The Caretaker, is synthetic and the voice is AI-generated.
